title: Bug: BGP neighbors not established after idf_isolation followed by config reload
author: vishal-nokia
body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

After running the following commands:
```
sudo idf_isolation isolated_no_export
sudo config save -y
sudo config reload -y
```
We see that the BGP neighbors are not established.
The neigbor entries are missing in running config as well.
This leads to test failures in `bgp/test_seq_idf_isolation.py`

```
sudo idf_isolation isolated_no_export
sudo config save -y
sudo config reload -y
```

comments.author: vishal-nokia
comments.body:
@tjchadaga , Here is my analysis.
The issue was introduced by [#21889](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/21889) which adds explicit exit commands to properly terminate router bgp context.
In [managers_bgp.py](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/src/sonic-bgpcfgd/bgpcfgd/managers_bgp.py), the `BGPPeerGroupMgr.update_pg()` method constructs the configuration command as:
``` Python
cmd = ('router bgp %s\n' % kwargs['bgp_asn']) + pg + tsa_rm + idf_isolation_rm + "\nexit"
```
which produces  a configuration like this when `idf_isolation` is set to `isolated_no_export`
``` 
router bgp 65100
  neighbor VOQ_CHASSIS_V4_PEER peer-group
  <peer-group configuration>
  <TSA route-map modifications>
route-map CHECK_IDF_ISOLATION permit 1
 match ip address prefix-list PL_LoopbackV4
 set community 12345:12345
...
exit
```
The `route-map` command is a global configuration command and cannot be defined inside `router bgp` context. With the explicit `exit` at the end, FRR treats everything between `router bgp` and `exit` as a single transaction block. The `route-map CHECK_IDF_ISOLATION` definition is silently rejected, and subsequent match commands fail with "Unknown command" because they appear outside any `route-map` context.
```
line 112: % Unknown command[28]: match ip address prefix-list PL_LoopbackV4
line 113: % Unknown command[28]: set community 12345:12345
```
 
TSA templates work since they modify existing route-maps by adding entries to `TO_BGP_PEER_V4`, `TO_BGP_PEER_V6`, etc. FRR allows modifying existing route-maps from within router bgp context.
IDF templates (idf_isolate.conf.j2) create a new `route-map CHECK_IDF_ISOLATION`. Creating new route-maps requires global configuration level.
 
We do not see this issue in the `unisolated` state since the `check_state_and_get_idf_isolation_routemaps()` method  in [managers_device_global.py](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/src/sonic-bgpcfgd/bgpcfgd/managers_device_global.py) only returns content when `idf_isolation_state != "unisolated"`. When `unisolated`, `idf_isolation_rm` is an empty string, so no route-map commands are injected.
 
### Proposed Fix:
Move `idf_isolation_rm` after the exit statement so that IDF isolation route-maps are defined at global configuration level.
In [managers_bgp.py](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/src/sonic-bgpcfgd/bgpcfgd/managers_bgp.py):
``` Python
if kwargs['vrf'] == 'default':
    cmd = ('router bgp %s\n' % kwargs['bgp_asn']) + pg + tsa_rm + "\nexit\n" + idf_isolation_rm
else:
    cmd = ('router bgp %s vrf %s\n' % (kwargs['bgp_asn'], kwargs['vrf'])) + pg + tsa_rm + "\nexit\n" + idf_isolation_rm
```
This produces the correct configuration order.
``` PlainText
router bgp 65100
  neighbor VOQ_CHASSIS_V4_PEER peer-group
  <peer-group configuration>
  <TSA route-map modifications>
exit
route-map CHECK_IDF_ISOLATION permit 1
 match ip address prefix-list PL_LoopbackV4
 set community 12345:12345
```

#### Why I did it
To ensure the template ends with the same frr configuration context (route-map context) for all isolation options. 

This is a workaround for https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/23616 which is caused by an assumption about the configuration context after the template is rendered

More details here - https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/24827#discussion_r2723255829

Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/23616
